newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower; concern over strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower; concern over strong dollar.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended lower Friday on concern that the strong dollar would hurt the overseas sales of corporate giants such as International Business Machines Corp. and Eastman Kodak Co.
Investors were also biding their time before a Federal Reserve meeting on Tuesday that could bring higher interest rates.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 15.49 points lower at 6,804.79. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 537 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
